  "explanation": "The request is accepted as an auditable upward reserve sizing study for CAISO with a 120-minute horizon and shortfall cost 40.0. Numerical outputs such as reserve values, mean costs, coverage values, confidence intervals, bootstrap claims, and dispatch results are produced only by the verified numerical workflow.",

    "task_type": "upward_reserve_sizing",
    "region_id": "CISO",
    "horizon_minutes": 120,
    "cost_reserve": 1.0,
    "cost_shortfall": 40.0,

      "train_days": 730,
      "cal_days": 30,
      "test_days": 30,
      "rolling_step_days": 30

    "requires_human_approval": true

  "workflow": [

    "configure_rolling_window_train_730_cal_30_test_30_step_30",

  ]
}
